title: UnattendedRequest
description: Deployment configuration for unattended bot execution. The bot runs on the device(s) associated with the specified runAsUser account, without requiring a logged-in Windows session.

runAsUsers.description: List of user IDs whose associated Bot Runner devices will execute the bot. Each user must have an unattended Bot Runner license.

poolIds.description: List of device pool IDs to target for execution. The bot will be dispatched to an available device in the specified pools.

items.description: Numeric ID of a device pool
